MANDATORY REVIEW ITEMS EVIDENCE
================================================================================

Item 1: Merkle Proof Construction
  Method: settlement-bundle.test.mjs test 9 (1,2,3,5,17,64,257,1024 leaves)
  Result: All proofs verified, tampered proofs rejected, deterministic ordering

Item 2: Domain Separation
  Parameters: block.chainid, address(this), challengeId, account, amount, role
  Test: claim_cross_deployment_replay_rejected invariant PASSES

Item 3: ERC-721 Soulbound
  Method: OpenZeppelin 5.6.1 ERC721.sol source analysis
  Result: All transfer paths (transferFrom, safeTransferFrom x2, _transfer,
          _safeTransfer, _burn) converge through _update() which is overridden
  ADV-01 confirms all 5 public methods revert

Item 4: OpenZeppelin 5.6.1
  Advisory: GHSA-wprv-93r4-jj2p (multiProofVerify) - NOT USED by TOKOIN
  Result: No applicable vulnerabilities

Item 5: Solidity 0.8.30
  Bug: TransientStorageClearingHelperCollision (HIGH) - requires viaIR - NOT USED
  Bug: InheritanceOrderReversalOnStorageEndWarning (MEDIUM) - no custom layout
  Bug: UnsoundSpillInMutualRecursion (MEDIUM) - requires viaIR - NOT USED
  Bug: LostStorageArrayWriteOnSlotOverflow (LOW) - probabilistically impossible
  Result: None triggered

Item 6: Gas Analysis
  1024-leaf claim: 107,843 gas, 10 proof nodes
  Block gas limit context: ~0.36% of 30M

Item 7: Unclaimed Fund Recovery
  Mechanism: releaseExpiredSettlement() + cancelSettlement()
  Verified: ADV-05 (double release), ADV-14 (non-expired rejected)

Item 8: Off-Chain Boundary
  Guards: dual-gate production denial, explicit enablement, rate limiting,
          MutatingOwner+CSRF, reservation-operator binding

Item 9: Multisig Governance
  Enforcement: SAFE_2_OF_3 attestation + 3 distinct addresses required
  Limitation: attestation-based, not on-chain verified

Item 10: Adversarial Tests
  15 tests executed, all passed
